mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish on the weather. Conditions are clear at Harriet Park, and we have a first quarter moon gracing the sky. If you are awake early tomorrow, the space station will be visible from 4:09 AM, tracking from Belleville toward the Fitchburg area. Expect an overnight low of 58 degrees with dry conditions.

The city has released updated engineering reports for public review, and work continues on the Mark Drive reconstruction, which involves utility upgrades and new sidewalk installations to improve community connectivity.
Today is packed with local options including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market and trivia at The Bogey Factory, followed by a concert in the park tomorrow at Century School Park.
In a report from last Friday, officers arrested a 44-year-old woman for her first offence O W I after responding to a vehicle that had come to a stop on the road.
Double Strawberry is the flavor of the day, and you have until 10 PM to pick up a scoop before they close for the evening.
